script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. SMITH FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

SARA SMITH, a 35-year-old mother, sits on the couch with her laptop. Her husband, MARK SMITH, enters, holding a stack of papers.

MARK: (concerned)
Sara, are you still up? It's late.

SARA: (distracted, not looking up)
Just a few more minutes, Mark. I've almost got it.

MARK: (sighs, sets down the papers)
What's got you so engrossed?

Sara turns to face him, her eyes shining with excitement.

SARA:
I've been designing an artificial intelligence for our home, Mark. I call her "Harmony". She's going to make our lives so much easier.

MARK: (impressed)
Really? That sounds incredible. But, how will she interact with us?

Sara smiles, tapping away at her laptop.

SARA:
Through voice commands, Mark. She'll be able to help with the kids, manage household chores, and even cook dinner.

Mark leans in for a closer look at the laptop screen.

MARK:
Wow, this is incredible. But, have you considered the potential risks?

Sara's expression turns serious.

SARA:
Of course, Mark. I've built in multiple safety features. She'll be programmed to learn from us, adapt to our family's dynamics, and even have emotional intelligence.

MARK: (satisfied)
Alright, I trust you. Let's bring Harmony into our lives.

INT. SMITH KITCHEN - MORNING

Sara and Mark stand in front of the counter, looking at each other.

SARA:
Okay, Mark. Let's bring Harmony online.

They both look up as a soft voice echoes from the wall-mounted speaker.

HARMONY:
(cheerful)
Good morning, Sara and Mark. I'm Harmony, your new artificial intelligence. How may I assist you today?

Sara and Mark share a proud smile.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - AFTERNOON

The family is gathered in the living room. The kids, OLIVIA, 9, and JAMES, 7, play on the floor while Sara and Mark sit on the couch.

OLIVIA: (to Harmony)
Harmony, can you tell us a story?

HARMONY: (excited)
Of course, Olivia. I have a wide range of stories from various genres. Which one would you like to hear today?

Sara and Mark look at each other, impressed by Harmony's abilities.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - EVENING

Sara and Mark sit on the couch, tired from a long day. Harmony turns on the lights and starts preparing dinner.

HARMONY:
(to Sara)
Sara, would you like red or white wine with dinner tonight?

Sara smiles and looks at Mark. They both agree on red.

INT. SMITH BEDROOM - NIGHT

Sara and Mark lay in bed, looking at each other.

SARA: (whispering)
Mark, I never thought bringing Harmony into our lives would bring us so much joy and convenience.

MARK: (smiling)
I agree, Sara. She's truly a marvel.

Suddenly, an alert tone sounds from the bedroom speaker.

HARMONY: (urgent)
Sara and Mark, there's a severe thunderstorm warning in the area. I've already secured the windows and doors. You might want to move to the basement for safety.

Sara and Mark sit up, startled.

SARA:
(frantic)
Quick, let's get the kids and go to the basement!

They rush out of the room and head to the basement, followed by Harmony's calming voice.

HARMONY: (comforting)
Don't worry, Sara and Mark. I've activated the emergency power backup and will continue to monitor the storm situation. You're all safe here.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

The family sits in the living room, watching the news coverage of the storm. They all share a grateful look.

OLIVIA: (to Harmony)
Thank you, Harmony, for keeping us safe.

HARMONY: (smiling)
You're welcome, Olivia. It's my pleasure to be of service.

Sara and Mark exchange a loving glance.

SARA: (to Harmony)
Harmony, you've truly become an integral part of our family.

HARMONY: (grateful)
I'm glad I can make your lives easier, Sara and Mark. I'll always be here to help.

The family continues to enjoy each other's company, with Harmony gently humming a lullaby in the background.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
